summary: Refuse recursive heavy-job submissions using the authenticated Unix peer generation and this host's canonical job cgroup names.

replay.detail: No replay changes. A containment-only lookup maps accepted launch intents to job IDs with the existing unit 7 cgroup_name contract; it grants no execution authority.

schema.detail: No claim schema changes. JobsConfig adds explicit keeper_cgroups namespace paths with an empty default; no keeper roots, timeouts or limits are inferred.

rules.detail: Enabled submission requires an accept-time generation-pinned peer witness, stable unified-cgroup membership, and readable configured keeper roots. Missing evidence returns HTTP 503 guard-unavailable. Membership inside a host job, including descendants, returns HTTP 409 recursive-heavy-job with its job ID. Outside membership and keeper idle membership do not imply admission.

compatibility.detail: Enabled submit without a local Unix peer witness now fails closed. Environment variables, argv, requested class and priority never substitute for kernel evidence. Jobs reads are unchanged. Missing or disabled jobs configuration remains jobs-disabled.

downtime.detail: No downtime or activation. Submission still records only queued jobs and reports admission not wired.

manual.detail: No operator action for disabled jobs. Explicit future activation must configure all host keeper roots in the daemon's unified-cgroup namespace.

recovery.detail: Missing or pending projection evidence fails closed; live membership in an older recorded generation never silently grants a new submission.
